d: US Market Crash, AI Selloff and a massive rally in the Indian Stock Market! While Wall Street witnessed one of its biggest market value losses, with Nasdaq, S&P 500 and Dow Jones plunging, Japan’s Nikkei and South Korea’s Kospi also suffered sharp declines. But India’s Sensex surged over 6,000 points in just six trading sessions, with Nifty also gaining more than 8%.
